description: Summarize one exact tool name or slug, or up to three examples from a specific category. Use this to check one tool's free plan; to compare tools, use compare_tools. No bulk exports, pagination or full records; visit SaaS Puppy for more.

category.description: Category to sample, for example "hosting". Returns at most three examples.

pricing_models.description: Optional filters: free-forever, free-trial, open-source, self-hosted.

query.description: Exact tool name or slug, for example "Neon" or "cloudflare-turnstile". Leave empty to sample a category.

name: list_tools
title: Summarize a tool or category
